Documentation.short_help: OpenFOAM extendedFeatureEdgeMesh: classified feature edges and points.
Documentation.long_help: Calls Foam::surfaceFeatures and Foam::extendedFeatureEdgeMesh (statically linked meshTools, same path as surfaceFeatureExtract). Input is a triangle surface. Output is feature lines with EdgeStatus (external/internal/flat/open/multiple), PointStatus (convex/concave/mixed/nonFeature), RegionEdge, and a FoamFile blob. Feed the output to SHYX SnappyHexMesh Feature edges to write constant/extendedFeatureEdgeMesh. Optional Extra feature edges are merged. Region array (cell data dropdown, default None) sets triSurface patches; adjacent cells with different ids become region edges. Cell array Baffle or Baffle all regions marks baffle patches (sideVolumeType BOTH).

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Triangle surface used for included-angle feature extraction.

InputProperty.name: ExtraFeatureEdges
InputProperty.label: Extra feature edges
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional extra polylines (VTK_LINE / VTK_POLY_LINE) merged into the extendedFeatureEdgeMesh. Leave (none) to extract only from the surface.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: IncludedAngle
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Included angle
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: OpenFOAM includedAngle (degrees). Adjacent faces whose included angle is less than this are feature edges. 0 selects none, 180 selects all.

IntVectorProperty.name: GeometricTestOnly
IntVectorProperty.label: Geometric test only
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Ignore region (patch-boundary) edges; classify by geometry only.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: TrimMinLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Trim min length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Delete feature strings shorter than this. 0 = off.

IntVectorProperty.name: TrimMinElements
IntVectorProperty.label: Trim min elements
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Delete feature strings with fewer edges than this. 0 = off.

IntVectorProperty.name: KeepOpenEdges
IntVectorProperty.label: Keep open edges
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Keep edges with one connected face (OPEN).

IntVectorProperty.name: KeepNonManifoldEdges
IntVectorProperty.label: Keep non-manifold edges
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Keep edges with more than two connected faces (MULTIPLE).

IntVectorProperty.name: BaffleAllRegions
IntVectorProperty.label: Baffle all regions
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Mark every surface patch as a baffle (sideVolumeType BOTH). Per-triangle cell array named Baffle still marks individual regions when this is off.

StringVectorProperty.name: RegionArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Region array
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Cell-data array of patch / region ids (OpenFOAM triSurface regions). Adjacent triangles with different ids become region edges. None: one region (id 0), classify by geometry only (and open / non-manifold).
